data.name: Plug Priority
data.detailed_description:
Plug Priority is a game where you play as a telephone exchange operator at the dawn of the 20th century, connecting callers to others!

The job is simple: People call your exchange, you listen for who they'd like to talk to and you make sure they reach that person! Listen carefully, and perhaps you'll catch some bits and pieces about what this town's residents are like.

  • Do your best to respond to calls as quickly as possible

  • Make sure the people that call you get connected to who they want to talk to

  • Ensure service is always perfect

  • Experience little bits and pieces of conversation throughout the decades as the sole employee of the telephone exchange

You take the role of Mandy, a young, toasted-marshmallow-furred, goat lady who just started her job at the town's brand new telephone exchange in the beautiful year of 1920!

While she's still new at the job, and was pretty much just dropped into the role via happenstance, and lack of other capable and/or reliable applicants, she does the best she can.

Seeing as the job pays well, keeps you busy and has reasonable work hours, why not stick around for a while?

Join us for discussions on the Steam Forums, report bugs, talk about what you like or dislike! Additionally, we have a Discord Server, and are always happy to welcome new folks!

Share fan art, suggest ideas for the game, whatever!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD FX-4100 or equivalent
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • VR Support: Meta Quest Headsets, Valve Index, HTC Vive
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • VR Support: Meta Quest Headsets, Valve Index, HTC Vive

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04/SteamOS 3.0 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD FX-4100 or equivalent
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 or equivalent (Vulkan 1.2+)
  • VR Support: Meta Quest Headsets, Valve Index, HTC Vive
linux_requirements.recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1070 or equivalent (Vulkan 1.2+)
  • VR Support: Meta Quest Headsets, Valve Index, HTC Vive
